image_prompts.persona_changeable_rule: Described freely — this is what makes two images read as two different days. Makeup stays minimal and consistent, because a changed face reads as a changed person.
image_prompts.register: Quiet wealth, lived in. Extremely wealthy and self-made, and you would not know it from looking at her or her house. Nice, never showy. Real, never run-down. Not AI-perfect, not a five-million-dollar mansion, not messy. Clean and natural, with the evidence of kids, dogs and farm animals in the room rather than the mess of them. Decor that suits her and complements the farmhouse.
image_prompts.register_scope: This governs persona PHOTOGRAPHY. The luxury-campaign register in the Prompt Library governs pin DESIGN. Not interchangeable.
image_prompts.standalone_rule: Every prompt is a complete standalone unit. Every image in a carousel or story set gets its own complete prompt — never a shared spec block plus fragments.
image_prompts.text_rule: Nano banana (Gemini): text is set, never generated — no lettering in frame. Canva AI renders text accurately; do not strip text from Canva prompts.
